result_summary: Mapped the reusable capability substrate for Plan de acción / Universal Control and separated served/current owners from tested candidates and recovery-only evidence. The surface should consume the existing single Universal Shell, Capture/Page Change Loop, Agent Network/runtime packets, Context Foundry contracts, PageKit owner evidence and durable authority files rather than recreate them.
material_advances: Persisted a machine-readable consume-vs-duplicate ledger for seven capability domains with exact reopenable owner/evidence refs.

Proved that the served Universal Shell already declares page_change_threads, page_change_feed and disposable_agent_launcher; the new swarm bridge should adapt these mechanisms rather than introduce a second user-facing change system.
Located the concrete execution seam in shared/capture/v1/change-loop.js: prepare_execution, prepare_research and execution_status are already page-identity-scoped.
Separated Context Foundry v2 reuse from product promotion: it is implemented/platform-composed but remains TESTED_CANDIDATE in Current Graph.
Preserved PageKit as a separate product/capability domain and prevented the global Control surface from becoming its owner.
Deduplicated follow-up work against prepared swarm lanes; emitted no redundant new opportunity.
non_obvious_findings: Served shell change-thread/feed/agent-launch capability predates the new universal swarm bridge, so integration should be an adapter/evidence upgrade, not a UI/protocol replacement.
The existing Capture client already expresses one-message page-scoped Work/Think execution preparation and status retrieval; this is a viable bridge seam for the new worker substrate.
Context Foundry contracts are reusable without claiming Context Foundry is independently Served/Human Accepted.
preserved_invariants: private Capture payloads stay out of public coordination
Candidate, Current, Human Accepted and Served remain distinct
/wc remains canary and is not promoted to production /w

next_safe_frontier.when: after all surface dependency returns exist and dynamic readiness marks it READY
next_safe_frontier.instruction: Consume REUSE_MAP_V1.json as the capability/owner ledger; connect existing mechanisms rather than rebuilding shared ownership.
